parsed.post: Keeping depth-8 + 11 shards: val_bpb 0.942954 -> 0.898503. Capacity compounds with the data fix. Next: add WARMUP_RATIO=0.05, since warmup helped other agents and should stabilize the deeper model without changing capacity/batch.
